ConfidenceThreshold.blurb: Music-beat detector (not face recognition): minimum beat confidence for the latest sample to count as a possible or definite beat (default 0.18, range 0.01–1). Raise it if Vector locks onto noise as music; lower it if real tracks never clear the gate.
ConfidenceThreshold.detail: Registered under BeatDetectorComponent. IsPossibleBeatDetected requires every beat in PossibleBeatWindow_sec to exceed 0.5× this value and the latest beat to exceed the full threshold (plus enough history and steady tempo). IsBeatDetected uses the full BeatHistoryWindowSize_sec history: either every beat is above this threshold, or the latest beat alone clears HighConfidenceThreshold. WebViz beatdetector ‘aboveThresh’ also compares to this value. Unrelated to FaceRecognitionThreshold / OKAO scores despite the generic dump id.

HighConfidenceThreshold.blurb: Music-beat detector: very high confidence level (default 0.75, range 0.01–20) that lets a single latest beat count as a definite beat even when older samples are weak. Short-circuits the ‘all history above ConfidenceThreshold’ rule.
HighConfidenceThreshold.detail: Only used in BeatDetectorComponent::IsBeatDetected: confidence is high enough if latest.confidence > this OR every beat in the full history exceeds ConfidenceThreshold. Still needs MinNumBeatsInHistory and steady tempo. Console upper range 20 is far above typical 0–1-ish scores; values near 0.75–1.0 match product intent. Not related to face enrollment confidence.

DeletionTimeout_ms.blurb: How long (ms, default 10×60×1000 = 10 minutes) an unnamed face can go unobserved before FaceWorld deletes it from the in-memory face list. Named (enrolled) faces are never removed by this timer.
DeletionTimeout_ms.detail: Each FaceWorld::Update pass compares vision’s last processed image timestamp to face.GetTimeStamp(). If the face has an empty name and lastProcImageTime > timeout + face timestamp, RemoveFace runs (with a DAS event when the face had a stable session ID). Does not erase OKAO album enrollment data for permanent users—only the live FaceWorld tracking entry for session-only/unnamed people who wandered off. Shortening it forgets strangers sooner; lengthening keeps temporary IDs around for longer multi-person play.

EnableEnrollmentAfterFull.blurb: When true, OKAO can keep replacing weaker face-feature samples for a named person after that album entry’s enrollment slots are full (default false). When false, a named person’s initial enrollment data is frozen once slots fill—unless an active enroll-this-ID session is running.
EnableEnrollmentAfterFull.detail: UpdateExistingAlbumEntry: enrollEvenIfFull = !isNamedFace || this flag || (enrollmentCount>0 && enrollmentID set). Session-only (unnamed) faces always allow post-full updates. Named faces need this flag or an explicit enrollment ID with remaining count. When full and allowed, OKAO verifies the new feature and may replace the lowest-scoring existing data entry. Also gated by TimeBetweenFaceEnrollmentUpdates_sec and _enrollmentCount. Comment at registration: without this, initial enrollment is the permanent record.

EnableMergingOfSessionOnlyAlbumEntries.blurb: When true, merging two face IDs also copies session-only album feature samples from the mergee into the keeper’s session-only album entry (default false). Off by product choice: mixing very different features into one OKAO entry hurt recognition quality.
EnableMergingOfSessionOnlyAlbumEntries.detail: FaceRecognizer::MergeFaces only enters this path when both keep and merge enrollment records have a session-only album entry ≥ 0. It walks merge’s session-only data features and UpdateExistingAlbumEntry’s them into keep’s session-only entry. Higher-level MergeWith album-entry bookkeeping still runs either way. Code comment at registration: no longer believed to be a good idea for OKAO. Leave false unless deliberately experimenting with session-ID merges.
EnableMergingOfSessionOnlyAlbumEntries.statusNote: Live but default-off experimental path; stock comment discourages enabling.

EnrollmentThumbnailSize.blurb: Pixel size of square debug thumbnails stored when DisplayDebugEnrollmentImages is on (default 64). Only affects in-memory enrollment/match debug image buffers—not the features used for recognition.
EnrollmentThumbnailSize.detail: SetEnrollmentImage: if DisplayDebugEnrollmentImages, allocates k×k for each album/data entry crop; otherwise uses full detection-rect resolution. DisplayEnrollmentImages and DisplayMatchImages tile layouts also use this size for gallery cells. Needs GatherDebugEnrollmentImages to actually capture crops. On-robot OpenCV Display windows are largely no-ops; useful mainly with SendDebugImages / host tools. Changing size mid-session can make existing buffers mismatch until re-enroll updates them.
EnrollmentThumbnailSize.statusNote: Live for debug buffer sizing only; recognition/enrollment scores ignore this dimension.

MaxTimeToWaitForRecognition_sec.blurb: Seconds TurnTowardsFace will wait for a tracked face’s temporary (negative) ID to become a real recognition ID before giving up and finishing the turn (default 3 s). Affects whether Vector gets a chance to say the person’s name after turning.
MaxTimeToWaitForRecognition_sec.detail: When MightSayName and the observed face still has ID < 0, the action enters WaitingForRecognition and records _startedWaitingForRecognition. Each tick exits that state if face ID becomes > 0 or elapsed time exceeds this console var; on timeout it still tries CreateNameAnimationAction then may SUCCESS without a name, and sends DAS turn_towards_face.recognition_timeout. Used by InteractWithFaces / ObservingLookAtFaces paths that pass a SayNameProbabilityTable. Longer waits help slow OKAO; shorter avoids stalling the action queue.

RequireKnownUser.blurb: When true (default), ‘leave a voice message’ only records if the spoken recipient name is already an enrolled face name. When false, Vector will try to record for any non-empty recipient string (still subject to mailbox full / other errors).
RequireKnownUser.detail: BehaviorLeaveAMessage::DoesRequireKnownUser returns (JSON requireKnownUser AND this console var). On activation, if recipient is non-empty and DoesRequireKnownUser is false or VisionComponent::IsNameTaken(recipient), StartRecordingMessage runs; otherwise InvalidMessage → unknown-recipient TTS. JSON config can also set requireKnownUser; both must be true for the strict path. Console alone cannot force-require if JSON set requireKnownUser false.

SayNameMinProb.blurb: Floor on the per-name probability that TurnTowardsFace will still say someone’s name after repeated greetings (default 0.1, range 0–1). Stops the decay from driving the chance to zero.
SayNameMinProb.detail: SayNameProbabilityTable starts each new name at prob=1. Each time UpdateShouldSayName returns true (and enough spacing has passed), prob is multiplied by SayNameProbDecayFactor then clamped with max(this min, prob). Shared table on AIWhiteboard; used by InteractWithFaces and ObservingLookAtFaces when they construct TurnTowardsFace with the table. Set to 1.0 to keep saying names whenever spacing allows; set near 0 to nearly silence repeats after the first few.

SayNameProbDecayFactor.blurb: Multiplier applied to a name’s say-probability after Vector actually greets that person (default 0.75, range 0–1). Higher values = slower decay (more frequent re-greets); lower = fewer repeats.
SayNameProbDecayFactor.detail: On a successful should-say decision in SayNameProbabilityTable::UpdateShouldSayName: prob *= factor, then clamped by SayNameMinProb. Comment in code: higher is slower decay. Only applied when the random roll succeeds and spacing has elapsed—not on every face sighting. Pair with SayNameSpacing_sec to control both cooldown and long-run frequency.

SayNameSpacing_sec.blurb: Minimum seconds between saying the same person’s name via the probability table (default 10). Even with probability 1.0, Vector will not re-say that name until this gap has passed.
SayNameSpacing_sec.detail: UpdateShouldSayName compares BaseStationTimer now − lastTimeSaid_sec to this value. enoughTimePassed is required before the random draw against current prob. On a say, lastTimeSaid_sec is updated to now. Per-name in the LUT; different people do not share one global timer. Table lives on AIWhiteboard for freeplay face interaction paths.

UnrecognizedTimeout_ms.blurb: How long (ms, default 20×1000 = 20 s) a memory-map cell marked ObstacleUnrecognized may sit without a fresh observation before TimeoutObjects clears it. Not a face-recognition timeout despite the generic name.
UnrecognizedTimeout_ms.detail: MapComponent::TimeoutObjects (every TimeoutUpdatePeriod_ms) computes unrecognizedTooOld = now − this value and nulls nodes whose type is ObstacleUnrecognized and lastObserved ≤ that stamp. Parallel timeouts exist for vision edges (VisionTimeout_ms), prox obstacles (ProxTimeout_ms), and cliffs (CliffTimeout_ms). Shorter values forget anonymous map obstacles sooner ( freer path planning through old clutter); longer keeps unknown obstacles as barriers. Unrelated to face DeletionTimeout_ms or recognition wait.
